title: A Simple and General Approach to top-$k$ Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.26407v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper considers the Bayesian top-$k$ identification problem, wherein a decision maker is tasked with selecting $k$ items from a pool of items of unknown quality. To assess the items, the decision maker adaptively allocates a fixed sampling budget, where each sample of an item yields a noisy observation of its quality, with the objective of minimizing the expected opportunity cost of the selected set. We propose an approach that allocates each batch of samples by minimizing a surrogate objective derived from an upper bound on the expected opportunity cost. The approach is general: samples can be allocated in batches, the selection size $k$ is arbitrary, and it applies to many sampling distributions. It is also simple and intuitive. We prove that the method's posterior expected opportunity cost decays at an exponential rate of at least half the best rate achievable by any sampling rule. translated_title: 一种简单而通用的top-$k$选择方法
translated_abstract: 本文研究了贝叶斯top-$k$识别问题，其中决策者的任务是从一组质量未知的物品中选出$k$个物品。为了评估这些物品，决策者需要自适应地分配固定的采样预算，每次对某个物品的采样都会产生对其质量的一个含噪观测，目标是最小化所选集合的期望机会成本。我们提出了一种方法，通过最小化由期望机会成本上界导出的替代目标来分配每一批采样。该方法具有通用性：采样可以按批次进行分配，选择数量$k$可以是任意的，并且适用于多种采样分布。该方法同时也简单直观。我们证明了该方法的后验期望机会成本以指数速率衰减，其速率至少达到任何采样规则所能达到的最佳速率的一半。在广泛的仿真设置中……
tldr: 本文提出一种通过最小化期望机会成本上界导出的替代目标来自适应分配采样批次的简单通用方法，用于解决贝叶斯top-$k$选择问题，并证明其后验期望机会成本的衰减速率至少达到任意采样规则最佳速率的一半。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a simple and general approach to Bayesian top-$k$ selection that adaptively allocates sampling batches by minimizing a surrogate objective derived from an upper bound on the expected opportunity cost, and proves its posterior expected opportunity cost decays exponentially at a rate of at least half the best achievable by any sampling rule.
